newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber steady in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber steady in lacklustre trade.

text.p: Rubber futures were mostly flat by midsession on Tuesday in lacklustre trade as ample supplies continued to drag the market down, dealers said.
"There was no offtake at all, it was zero this morning. Nobody wanted to trade," a local rubber trader said.
"It's going to remain soft over the short-term because production and supplies remained ample," a commodity house dealer said.
Higher prices in Japan failed to lift the market out of its doldrums, traders said. "Sentiment was basically flat," one dealer said.
At around 0445 GMT, November RSS3 was indicated unchanged at 128.00 U.S. cents a kg.
November RSS1 was indicated at 184.50-186.50 Singapore cents (US$1.31-$1.33) a kg from Monday's settlement of 185.50 cents.
November TSR20 was indicated at 177.00-179.00 Singapore cents (US$1.26-$1.28) a kg against the previous 178.00 cents.
